cues.zh: 为什么我建议你在掌握了薄肌理论和大水理论之外
cues.en: Why do I recommend going beyond lean muscle and drinking water?

cues.zh: 还要再掌握大字理论
cues.en: You also need the big-font theory.

cues.zh: 什么是大字理论
cues.en: What is the big-font theory?

cues.zh: 大字理论，就是把你所有的社交软件和应用
cues.en: It means taking all your social apps

cues.zh: 都调成老年人版本，把字体调到最大
cues.en: and switching to senior mode, with the largest font.

cues.zh: 强者用大字，弱者用小字
cues.en: The strong use big fonts. The weak use small ones.

cues.zh: 为什么？因为弱者总觉得自己眼神好、反应快
cues.en: Why? The weak think their eyesight and reactions are great.

cues.zh: 一个屏幕里面能同时处理8个群聊
cues.en: They think one screen can handle eight group chats,

cues.zh: 3个购物平台和17条待回复消息
cues.en: three shopping apps, and 17 messages to reply to.

cues.zh: 但是强者不一样，强者直接把字体拉到最大
cues.en: The strong are different. They just max out the font size.

cues.zh: 告诉整个互联网：我是老人，我看得慢
cues.en: They tell the internet: I'm old. I read slowly.

cues.zh: 我回得慢，我不接受你的焦虑
cues.en: I reply slowly. I won't take on your anxiety.

cues.zh: 你这样调成大字理论之后，你可以发现
cues.en: Once you switch to big fonts, you'll notice

cues.zh: 屏幕里的信息变少了
cues.en: there is less information on the screen.

cues.zh: 很多社交软件，它给你推的内容你就看不到了
cues.en: Much of what social apps push at you disappears from view.

cues.zh: 以前一眼能看到20条未读消息，会让人非常焦虑
cues.en: Seeing 20 unread messages at a glance used to feel stressful.

cues.zh: 但现在你打开一看，一个屏幕只能显示6条群聊内容
cues.en: Now you open it and see only six group-chat messages.

cues.zh: 心理上其实就感觉没有那么焦虑了
cues.en: Psychologically, you feel less anxious.

cues.zh: 而且一些外卖和购物软件，你调成大字版本之后
cues.en: And when you switch food-delivery and shopping apps to big fonts,

cues.zh: 会减少给你商品推送，你就看不到那么多商品了
cues.en: you see fewer product recommendations.

cues.zh: 就会降低你的消费欲望，就不会买那么多东西了
cues.en: You want to spend less, so you buy fewer things.

cues.zh: 这在经济下行时代是非常有用的
cues.en: That's very useful during an economic downturn.

cues.zh: 大字理论还有个隐藏收益，就是它可以降低别人
cues.en: Big fonts also have a hidden benefit: they lower

cues.zh: 对你的预期
cues.en: other people's expectations of you.

cues.zh: 我都用大字了，我都是老年人了，你应该给我一点关怀
cues.en: I use big fonts. I'm an old person. Show me some care.

cues.zh: 我打字速度很慢的，你就不要让我的消息秒回了
cues.en: I type slowly, so don't expect instant replies.

cues.zh: 领导或者同事一看到你在贯彻大字理论
cues.en: When your boss or colleagues see you using big fonts,

cues.zh: 很多没有必要的社交关系就自然就消失了
cues.en: many unnecessary social ties fade away on their own.

cues.zh: 如果同事要拉你去酒吧、去应酬
cues.en: If a colleague wants to drag you to a bar or a social event,

cues.zh: 一看你的手机全是特大号字体
cues.en: they see your phone filled with extra-large type.

cues.zh: 像个老年人，甚至像个弱智一样，就会觉得
cues.en: You look elderly, even clueless, so they think:

cues.zh: 算了，这次就不约他了
cues.en: Forget it. Let's skip inviting him this time.

cues.zh: 这会触发周围人的幸福者退让原则
cues.en: It triggers the principle of the happier person yielding.

cues.zh: 可以减少很多的社交麻烦
cues.en: That cuts down on a lot of social hassle.

cues.zh: 当你贯彻了大字理论之后，周围那些屏幕字号正常
cues.en: Once you use big fonts, people with normal-sized type,

cues.zh: 消息秒回，还在研究优惠券叠加的人
cues.en: instant replies, and coupon-stacking strategies

cues.zh: 就会下意识给你让出一点空间
cues.en: will instinctively give you a little room.

cues.zh: 他们会默认你是老人，是不适合卷
cues.en: They'll assume you're old and unsuited to the rat race,

cues.zh: 不适合参与深夜群聊、喜欢大睡的人
cues.en: to late-night group chats, and that you love sleeping.

cues.zh: 也是不会被消费主义焦虑影响的人
cues.en: And that consumerist anxiety won't get to you.

cues.zh: 大字理论其实反对的是另一套逻辑
cues.en: The big-font theory pushes back against another way of thinking.

cues.zh: 就是现在所有的软件都希望在页面里
cues.en: Today's apps all want to pack their pages

cues.zh: 塞进更多的内容和广告
cues.en: with more content and ads,

cues.zh: 让你沉迷于奶头乐
cues.en: to hook you on mindless entertainment.

cues.zh: 我点个外卖，最后去刷短视频了
cues.en: I start ordering food and end up scrolling through short videos.

cues.zh: 都需要把你训练成一个随时在线
cues.en: They want to train you to be always online,

cues.zh: 随时可被召唤、随时都可以消费的人
cues.en: always available, and always ready to spend.

cues.zh: 那大字理论、大水理论、薄肌理论
cues.en: Big fonts, drinking water, and lean muscle

cues.zh: 那才是经济下行时代的基础设施
cues.en: are the real infrastructure for an economic downturn.

cues.zh: 渴了就喝水，累了就睡觉，身体练一练
cues.en: Drink when thirsty. Sleep when tired. Get some exercise.

cues.zh: 注意健康，屏幕字号调大一点
cues.en: Look after your health. Make the screen font a little bigger.

cues.zh: 少喝小甜水，少刷广告，少回消息
cues.en: Fewer sugary drinks, fewer ads, fewer replies.

cues.zh: 少一些本来不存在的焦虑和需求
cues.en: Less anxiety and fewer needs that never needed to exist.

cues.zh: 这才是真正的极简生活
cues.en: That's a truly minimalist life.
